name: @repo/ai-approval
description: Human-in-the-loop approval card where the chosen option expands to fill the card while the alternatives collapse away.

useCases: Question an agent asks before acting
Destructive action that needs a human yes
compositionHints: The decision is visibly irreversible in one spring — that is the point
Pass onDecide to receive the chosen option id
Keep option labels short; they become the resolved state
